intro.text: The young daughter of Nanrovah, a Hallandren high priest, kept in a cage by thieves until Vasher and Vivenna free her.
The young daughter of Nanrovah, a Hallandren high priest, kidnapped so that Denth could force her father to argue for war with Idris.

items.text: Thieves snatch Misel from her carriage in T'Telir under cover of distractions staged by Denth's crew, and lock her in a filthy cage in their den. When Vasher and Vivenna find her, she shrinks away from Vivenna but runs straight to Vasher once his fight is over.

On the walk home she is too shaken to speak, until Vasher has her repeat a Command that seems to wipe the ordeal from her mind. She then talks normally and asks for her parents, who are overjoyed to have her back.
With his daughter safe, Nanrovah withdraws his support for the war.
